reports.summary: Yemeni government forces shoot down Houthi drone in Taiz
reports.text: TAIZ — Yemeni government forces shot down a Houthi drone carrying a mortar shell in the Kadha front west of Taiz governorate.

reports.summary: Yemeni army secures positions in Taiz amid ongoing clashes
reports.text: Yemeni government forces secured positions on Mount Numan in Jabal Habashi, west of Taiz, and targeted Houthi reinforcements amid ongoing clashes in the western and southwestern fronts of the governorate.

reports.summary: Yemeni armed forces target Houthi positions in Hajjah
reports.text: HAJJAH — The armed forces targeted Houthi fortifications, barracks, and gatherings in several frontlines in Hajjah governorate.

reports.summary: Houthi health ministry reports casualties in Jawf air strikes
reports.text: AL-JAWF — The Houthi-run health ministry reported that four people were killed and three others injured in air strikes targeting communications towers in al-Khab wa al-Sha'af district in Jawf governorate.

reports.summary: Taiz residents send food convoy to government fighters in western fronts
reports.text: Residents of the city of al-Turbah in al-Sama'itin district in Taiz governorate dispatched a food convoy named the "Loyalty Convoy" to support government forces stationed on the western fronts of the governorate.

reports.summary: Trump: US president called off planned strikes against Houthis in Yemen
reports.text: Trump decided against launching US strikes against the Houthis in Yemen after initially ordering the Defense Department to prepare the operation following urging from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.

reports.summary: Houthi drone targets camp in Aden
reports.text: Houthi forces launched a booby-trapped drone that targeted a military camp in the Jaoula area of Aden, resulting in casualties among Peninsula Shield forces.

reports.summary: Trump administration officials: Trump decided against ordering air strikes on Yemen
reports.text: Trump administration officials said Trump decided against ordering air strikes on Yemen at present, after briefly asking the Pentagon to prepare for strikes following a personal appeal from Mohammed bin Salman on Thursday. Most of Trump's inner circle opposed opening another front in the war.

reports.summary: Clashes reported without territorial change in Al-Turbah in Taiz
reports.text: Clashes are underway in Al-Turbah in Taiz without territorial control by Yemeni Ansar Allah forces or territorial advances from either side.
A rocket launch operation was reported originating from Sanaa.

reports.summary: Saree: Saudi jets carried out 28 strikes in 24 hours
reports.text: TAIZ — Saudi warplanes carried out 28 air strikes using F-15 and Typhoon aircraft taking off from Khamis Mushait and Taif air bases, targeting Taiz, Al-Jawf and Marib governorates.

reports.summary: al-Mashat: Saudi escalation met the steadfastness of the Yemeni people
reports.text: al-Mashat stated that the escalation faced the steadfastness of the Yemeni people, and that Saudi Arabia evaded implementing the roadmap during the truce.

reports.summary: Yemeni transport ministry reports 316 ships crossed Bab al-Mandab
reports.text: A transport ministry source stated that 316 ships crossed the Bab al-Mandab strait between September 10 and 18, with a daily average of about 35 ships.

reports.summary: Saree: Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks on Riyadh and Yanbu
reports.text: RIYADH — Yemeni Armed Forces spokesperson Saree stated that forces launched ballistic and cruise missiles and drones at Riyadh and Aramco facilities in Yanbu following Saudi airstrikes originating from Khamis Mushait and Taif bases.

reports.summary: Saree: Saudi jets launched 26 air strikes on Taiz in 24 hours
reports.text: TAIZ — Yemeni Armed Forces spokesperson Saree stated that Saudi warplanes launched 26 air strikes on Taiz over 24 hours, and 300 total strikes over the week across Taiz, Hajjah, Marib, al-Jawf, al-Bayda, Amran, Lahj, Hodeidah, and Saada, taking off from Khamis Mushait and Taif bases.
